notes: Profile-based curated skill packs. Default profile is lean; core-next is recommended for Next.js full-stack work. skills-install-recommended reads this at runtime.

installRules.guidance: Do not install multiple overlapping packs for the same purpose unless the user explicitly asks.

overlapCaps.note: Prefer selected SEO skills; full pack only on request
ECC minimal by default; avoid stacking with plugin install

profiles.name: Lean Daily Coding
profiles.description: Fast default for everyday coding with UI polish and code review.
recommendedFor: slow Cursor or Claude Code setups

profiles.name: Core Next.js Lite
profiles.description: Next.js full-stack essentials without Graphify — for smaller sites and faster harnesses.

profiles.name: Core Next.js Full-Stack
profiles.description: Best default for Next.js, Tailwind, ShadCN, Prisma, MongoDB, and agency/client projects (core-next-lite + Graphify).

profiles.name: Growth + SEO/GEO
profiles.description: Public websites and content-driven apps without installing the full 20-skill SEO suite.

profiles.name: Audit / Review
profiles.description: Codebase cleanup, refactors, and security reviews without default UI design skills.

profiles.name: Experimental Heavy
profiles.description: Large experimental install — high bloat, not for daily defaults.

packs.name: Impeccable
packs.description: Design language for agent harnesses — UI/UX quality, anti-slop patterns, frontend polish workflows.

global.summary: User-wide skill (Claude/Cursor agents paths via skills CLI)

packs.name: Graphify
packs.description: Turns any folder of code, schemas, scripts, docs, papers, images, or video into a queryable knowledge graph for project navigation (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and more).
packs.warning: Python-based. The PyPI package is graphifyy (double-y). Requires uv, pipx, or pip; uv/pipx are preferred so the package lives in its own env and `graphify` resolves Python at runtime.

global.command: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install
global.summary: Install the graphifyy Python package via uv, then register the skill with global agents

project.command: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install --project
project.summary: Install the package globally, then register the skill into the current project

alternatives: pip install --user graphifyy && graphify install (add ~/.local/bin or ~/Library/Python/<ver>/bin to PATH if needed)
Per-IDE project install: graphify claude install --project, graphify codex install --project

packs.name: Awesome Code Review
packs.description: Modular code-review skill for Claude Code — 19+ languages/frameworks (React 19, Vue 3, Rust, Go, TypeScript, TanStack Query v5, …) loaded progressively with a four-phase review process and six-level severity scale.
packs.warning: Git-based install (not npx). Syncs the repo into ~/.claude/skills/code-review-skill/ (or ./.claude/skills/ for project scope). Re-runs clone once, then `git pull --ff-only`. Fails if the target path exists but is not a git repository.

global.summary: Sync the repo into the user's global Claude skills directory

project.summary: Sync the repo into the current project's .claude/skills/ directory

alternatives: Add to an existing plugin: cp -r code-review-skill ~/.claude/plugins/<your-plugin>/skills/code-review/

Fetch the tarball instead of cloning: curl -L https://github.com/awesome-skills/code-review-skill/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$HOME/.claude/skills/" && mv "$HOME/.claude/skills/code-review-skill-main" "$HOME/.claude/skills/code-review-skill"

packs.name: SEO & GEO Skills
packs.description: Suite of 20 SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 35+ AI agents — keyword research, competitor analysis, content writing, technical audits, schema markup, rank tracking, and more.
packs.warning: Full pack installs 20 skills + 20 slash commands. Profiles install only selected skills unless mode is full. Append -s <name> per skill for manual installs.

global.summary: Install all 20 SEO/GEO skills to the user's global agent skills directory

project.summary: Install all 20 SEO/GEO skills into the current project
Install one SEO/GEO skill into the current project

global.summary: Install selected SEO/GEO skills globally in one skills CLI run (space-separated after -s)

project.summary: Install selected SEO/GEO skills into the current project in one skills CLI run

alternatives: Claude plugin: /plugin marketplace add aaron-he-zhu/seo-geo-claude-skills (then /plugin install aaron-seo-geo)

packs.name: Everything Claude Code (ECC)
packs.description: Agent-harness performance optimization system — skills, agents, hooks, rules, and commands for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode. Minimal profile ships ~3–5 agents and ~10–15 skills; full is much larger.
packs.warning: Do not stack install methods — if you've already added ECC via /plugin install, do not also run the npx installer (and vice versa).

profiles.description: Minimal: rules, agents, commands, core workflow skills; no hooks-runtime (~3-5 agents, ~10-15 skills). Recommended.
Core: standard install. Pair with --without baseline:hooks to keep hooks off
Full: complete installer (28 agents, 119 skills). Explicit opt-in only

global.summary: Install ECC with the selected profile into the user's global Claude config

project.summary: Install ECC with the selected profile for the current project

alternatives: Plugin path: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC && /plugin install ecc@ecc
Override profile: --ecc-profile minimal|core|full on npx kenmark-skills install-recommended
